name: Liquid Glass GameCore
description: iOS-inspired dark glass theme: a translucent glossy material, iOS spring motion and a Control Center slider for how much of it the app wears.
changelog: 1.2.0 — the theme now asks for the material it is named after: a translucent, glossed surface with a drifting highlight that settles on an iOS-style spring, plus an Intensity control in the Glass Control Center. Needs GameCore 3.16 or newer; on Android 11 and below the panels are translucent, rimmed and glossed against a sharp backdrop, because backdrop blur is an Android 12 feature.
